# Infinity Craft Space

> Infinity Craft Space is an Indian online store for handcrafted gifts and craft products: custom resin art, personalised gifts, jewellery, artificial flower hair accessories (jadabilla, Jasmine and Mullai strings), embroidery hoops, crochet keychains and craft supplies. Products ship across India.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://infinitycraftspace.com/): featured and popular products
- [All products](https://infinitycraftspace.com/products): full catalogue; filter with ?category=NAME, search with ?q=TERM
- [Contact us](https://infinitycraftspace.com/contact-us)
- [Return policy](https://infinitycraftspace.com/return-policy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://infinitycraftspace.com/terms-and-conditions)
- [Privacy policy](https://infinitycraftspace.com/privacy-policy)

## Catalogue notes
- Every product page lives at /product/{slug} and includes price in INR, availability, description and structured data (schema.org Product).
- Jasmine string and Mullai string products are sold by length (4, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 32 inch); each length has its own price.
- Some products are made to order and can be personalised; processing time is shown on the product page.

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://infinitycraftspace.com/sitemap.xml): every active product URL with last-modified dates
